messages:
From: Helen Park <helen@acmeanalytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-20T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Azure marketplace image/bundle packaging + co-sell inquiry

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this — I'm Helen, Head of Partnerships at Acme Analytics. We're preparing an Azure Marketplace listing for our managed analytics appliance and exploring Redwood's "sell-with" / co-sell path. High level asks:

- We need guidance on packaging a VM/AMI-like image (we currently produce a deployable Linux VM + startup script) and the recommended bundle structure for Azure Managed Application + Marketplace VM images.
- Any constraints on runtime (CUDA / GPU support) when customers deploy via the Marketplace?
- Co-sell readiness: what evidence does Redwood require to carry the listing (joint demo assets, SOC2 artifacts, case studies)?
- Timeline: Acme is aiming for submission before Dec 20 to hit Q1 joint pipeline.

I've attached a preliminary packaging spec (acme_packaging_spec.yml) and a short list of our co-sell materials. Can we do a 30-minute technical intake early next week? I'm happy to include our technical PM and our Azure ISV contact.

Thanks —
Helen Park
Head of Partnerships, Acme Analytics
helen@acmeanalytics.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: acme_packaging_spec.yml, co_sell_evidence.zip

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Helen Park <helen@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-20T18:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure marketplace image/bundle packaging + co-sell inquiry

Hi Helen — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the spec; I skimmed the YAML and it looks like a good starting point.

Quick answers up front:
- Packaging: Redwood recommends shipping a minimal VM image + init script and a managed application wrapper for Azure. For GPU-enabled images we prefer passing through GPU drivers at provisioning time and using our recommended entrypoint scripts (we'll share a template).
- Runtime: Azure Marketplace deploys vary by SKU; GPU-enabled VMs are supported but you'll need to sign off on driver licensing and kernel modules. We'll coordinate with our infra team for validated instance types.
- Co-sell evidence: we typically need a short joint demo deck, a 1-pager for the marketplace listing, SOC2 summary (not full report), and a customer reference or pilot note.

Next steps I'd propose:
1) 30m technical intake (Mon 11/22 or Tue 11/23) — please share attendees.
2) Redwood tech checklist + AMI/VM packaging template (I'll attach).
3) Internal alignment: Ben (partnerships) and Olga (catalog/evidence) are looped to scope co-sell readiness.

Ben / Olga — can you join a quick internal sync after the intake to plan evidence handoff and SKU mapping?

Helen — I'm proposing Tue 11/23 10:00am PT for the intake. Does that work?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood_marketplace_packaging_template.md

From: Helen Park <helen@acmeanalytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: mark.sanders@acmeanalytics.com
Date: 2026-11-21T08:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure marketplace image/bundle packaging + co-sell inquiry

Karthik — thanks, Tue 11/23 10am PT works. I'll bring our Technical PM (Mark) and our Azure ISV contact (Mark Sanders copied).

A few clarifications before we meet:
- Our image currently bundles CUDA 11.8 and an OpenTelemetry agent. We expect customers to pick GPU SKUs; can Redwood confirm which Azure SKUs you've validated for low-latency inference?
- We also have a licensing concern: our runtime includes a third-party NNE license that requires host-approved drivers. Happy to share the license text during the intake.

Attached: azure_marketplace_requirements.pdf (our internal checklist).

Looking forward to the call.

Cheers,
Helen

Attachment: azure_marketplace_requirements.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-23T13:10:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Acme Analytics marketplace intake prep — roles and asks

Ben / Olga — quick internal note after the intake (notes below) so we have a single source of truth before we respond to Acme.

Summary from 11/23 intake with Acme (Mark + Helen):
- Acme wants Azure Marketplace VM + Managed App option; image includes CUDA 11.8 and a 3rd-party NNE library with a driver license requirement.
- Timeline: Acme wants to submit by Dec 20; realistic go/no-go depends on packaging tweaks + evidence.
- Co-sell asks: joint demo script, a vetted SOC2 summary, and at least one pilot reference.
- Technical ask for us: validated SKU list for GPU inference, packaging template for managed app + VM images, and an ops-runbook for support escalation cadence.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Ben: lead commercial path & co-sell cadence; confirm what evidence Redwood will host vs what Acme must host. ETA: 11/30.
- Olga: validate catalog metadata and required artifacts for Marketplace intake; map required docs (SOC2 excerpt, 1-pager, listing copy). ETA: 11/29.
- Karthik: get infra to validate GPU SKUs + driver constraints; own technical template updates for CUDA/driver handling. ETA: 11/27.
- Ops ask: draft a short runbook for troubleshooting customer-deployed images (I'll request from runtime oncall). ETA: 12/03.

Notes on licensing: The NNE license calls for "approved driver" installation; legal will likely require a short FAQ and optional documented steps for customers — we should preempt with a packaging note.

Ben / Olga — ping me here with any blockers. I'll collate an email reply to Acme with our next steps after you confirm.

Thanks,
Karthik

2) SKU validation — infra is validating a shortlist of Azure GPU SKUs (NC, ND families) for low-latency inference. Expect confirmation by 2026-11-27.
3) Evidence for co-sell — Ben will follow up on commercial asks (joint deck, 1-pager, pilot reference). Olga will send a precise catalog artifact list and submission checklist (ETA 11/29).
4) Licensing note — please send the NNE license text; we'll loop Legal early. If there are host-driver restrictions we may need a small customer-facing FAQ and a clear install path.

Can you confirm:
- a) Who will sign the Azure ISV forms?
- b) Do you have a pilot customer who can be listed as a reference for the co-sell (even limited)?

Meeting: I'll schedule a 20m internal sync (Ben/Olga/infra) after we get SKU validation.

Appreciate the fast turnaround on the materials — if you want to escalate timeline we can prioritize the template and runbook.

Best,
